data.description: SQL编程练习 - RIGHT JOIN和FULL JOIN

text:
-- RIGHT JOIN: 查询所有订单及其用户信息
SELECT o.order_id, o.amount, u.name, u.email
FROM users u
RIGHT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'pending';

-- 查询订单和支付记录
SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.amount AS order_amount,
    p.payment_id,
    p.amount AS payment_amount,
    p.payment_method
FROM orders o
RIGHT JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id;

-- FULL OUTER JOIN（部分数据库支持）
-- 查询所有用户和所有订单的完整关系
SELECT
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.name,
    o.order_id,
    o.amount
FROM users u
FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
